👉 **This PR is the next release.** Merging it bumps the version, appends to [`CHANGELOG.md`](../blob/main/CHANGELOG.md), creates the `vX.Y.Z` tag and GitHub Release, then fires [`release.yml`](../actions/workflows/release.yml) to ship both stores.

Where it lands and what it changes is checked live against Play and App Store Connect on every update. See the block above for this release. Full pipeline in [docs/practices/release.md](../blob/main/docs/practices/release.md).
